notes: The physical package is the Super Rare Games numbered release SRG#129. The publisher page identifies the base product and independent contemporary coverage names it the Standard Edition.

The rear physical image exposes HAC-P-BGQRA and the packaging code TSA-HAC-BGQRA-UKV. OGDB independently records the United Kingdom release and HAC-P-BGQRA / HAC-BGQRA-UKV, so the physical box is documented as UK rather than Spain-specific.

GameFAQs and Tokyo Game Story classify the same physical product more broadly as Europe; Super Rare Games sold the region-free product directly for worldwide use. These distribution descriptions do not create separate regional box variants.
The current official SRG page explicitly records a quantity update from the initially announced run to 4,000 copies; the official #BLUD site independently states 4,000 total copies.
No game-card label image was available from the sealed listings, so a cartridge serial is not assigned.
